input.answer:
Average weekly earnings including overtime for all employees (all industries, seasonally adjusted, Canada) were $1,354.55 in August 2026, per StatCan table 14-10-0222. This is the industrial aggregate excluding unclassified businesses, the closest all-industries measure I could retrieve.

Caveat: the all-industries series in table 14-10-0220 (industrial aggregate including unclassified businesses) returned null (suppressed) for every month I requested (2025-10 to 2026-08), so I could not use it. The null values are not zeros.

Change from July 2026 (computed): $1,354.55 − $1,347.35 = +$7.20; $7.20 / $1,347.35 = +0.5% (0.534%).

Values fetched: May 2026 $1,336.30; June 2026 $1,343.77; July 2026 $1,347.35; August 2026 $1,354.55.
